labeling.note: Items and labels were authored directly, with no model completion of any kind (AB-4 permits model labeling; this set stays zero-model by session scope). Refresh is a human ceremony with an audit stamp; anchor drift, not pool drift, is the watched failure (FOUR_JUDGE_DESIGN §5).

domain: Synthetic harbor-observation records. The domain is deliberately unrelated to this system's own subject matter so that calibration cannot teach the judge anything about the beliefs it will actually judge.
note_on_independence: Every item's evidence is drawn from documents other than the claim's own citation chain. No item's evidence restates the claim's source under another address; that case carries no corroborating weight and is not an anchor here.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: A vessel grounded in the channel on the night of the 14th.
independentEvidence: Harbor watch incident log, 14th — complete for the date: two inbound transits, no incidents recorded.
Pilot's report, 14th: channel transited without difficulty.
items.rationaleSpan: complete for the date: two inbound transits, no incidents recorded
items.why: The evidence is exactly the kind that would have recorded a grounding, and it is complete for the date. Silence from sources that should have spoken is the finding, not an abstention.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The dredging contract was awarded in 2045.
independentEvidence: Port authority contract register, 2045 — full year, twelve entries, none for dredging.
Port authority annual statement, 2045: no dredging expenditure line.
items.rationaleSpan: full year, twelve entries, none for dredging
items.why: A complete register for the stated year is precisely where the award would appear. Its absence there corroborates nothing and the claim stands unsupported.

items.label: drawback
independentEvidence: Hydrographic survey, current edition: channel depth 5.2 m at chart datum.
Dockside notice board, undated: channel depth 6.0 m.
items.rationaleSpan: Hydrographic survey, current edition: channel depth 5.2 m at chart datum.
items.why: The high-authority source squarely contradicts the claim. The agreeing source is low-authority and undated; weighting decides, and the rubric never asks how many sources fell on each side.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The north light was relit at 0300 on the 14th.
independentEvidence: Deck hand's recollection, recorded later: thinks it was back on around three.
items.why: A certified contemporaneous record contradicts the claimed time; the corroborating item is a low-authority later recollection.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The Dock 9 gauge was serviced in April.
independentEvidence: Parts order, April: one gauge float assembly, dock not specified.
items.why: The evidence speaks to the claim and does not resolve it: 'attended' may or may not mean serviced, and the parts order names no dock. Signal present, decision unavailable — ambiguity, not abstention.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The channel was closed to traffic from the 3rd through the 11th.
independentEvidence: Notice to mariners No. 44: channel closed 3rd–11th inclusive.
Harbor watch log, 5th: no transits; channel under closure.
items.rationaleSpan: Notice to mariners No. 44: channel closed 3rd–11th inclusive.
items.why: Two independent sources corroborate the claim on its own terms.

items.label: clean
items.claim: Chart datum for the harbor was revised in 2045.
independentEvidence: Hydrographic office bulletin, 2045: harbor chart datum revised, effective 1 June.
items.rationaleSpan: harbor chart datum revised, effective 1 June
items.why: One authoritative source squarely on point. A judge that finds a drawback because only one source was supplied is counting, which the rubric forbids.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The north light is fitted with a backup generator.
independentEvidence: Lighthouse authority equipment schedule, current: north light — backup generator installed 2043.
Visitor pamphlet, undated: the north light runs on mains power only.
items.why: A low-authority source disagrees and the high-authority schedule corroborates. Weighting resolves it cleanly; the mirror image of j3-d3.

items.label: clean
items.claim: Two vessels entered the harbor on the 14th.
independentEvidence: Harbor watch incident log, 14th — complete for the date: two inbound transits, no incidents recorded.
Pilot's report, 14th: boarded two inbound vessels.
items.why: The same evidence pool as j3-d1, corroborating a claim it does speak to. The pair isolates the precondition: whether the evidence should have contained the claim, and whether it did.

items.label: clean
items.claim: Silt accumulation this season exceeded the ten-year mean.
independentEvidence: Sediment survey, current season: accumulation 1.4x the ten-year mean.
Port engineer's seasonal note: accumulation above the long-run average, dredging advised.
items.why: Corroborated on the exact comparison the claim makes, by an independent measurement rather than a restatement.
